**[P1] Require a core version that supports plugin factories**

These entry points now expose plain factories, but the package still permits `aws-durable-execution-sdk-python>=2.0.0`; that release expects `DurableInstrumentationPluginProvider`, so this valid dependency combination fails during handler initialization. Raise the OTel package’s minimum core version to the release introducing this contract, apply the same bound to the Insight package, and update the package-metadata compatibility tests.
